fusions.name: Shot Over the Tailboard
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. An arrow loosed as you pull away deals 20 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and slows the target by 30% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once from the moving bed, spread apart; each deals 2 damage, with a 20% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Loosed From the String
fusions.desc: Draws you back and releases you 5 tiles forward. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Level Firing Bed
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your damage rises by 12%.
